issue_request: FHIR-19357 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request raised against STU3 HealthcareService. It requested replacing HealthcareService.programName with a 0..* CodeableConcept program element, adding an example binding to the listed program codes, and updating the affected search parameter from string to token.
initial_application: Git commit bd89a75a69817d9d8a4b5590860ee5921f19e8c6 explicitly included GF#19357 and changed the old HealthcareService source format so the resource used HealthcareService.program, introduced program terminology artifacts and an example using <program>, and made the program search parameter token-based on HealthcareService.program. Later source-rework commits carried that applied state into the current XML source files.
additional_context: HealthcareService is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The current FHIR model-definition library also exposes HealthcareService.program as a list of FHIR.CodeableConcept. The only current source hit for programName is in the separate 2016 QUICK model-definition example, not in HealthcareService resource source or the current FHIR model definition. PA Baltimore WGM minutes mention related HealthcareService search-parameter naming work, and no direct Zulip or Confluence reference was found that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was needed because source/healthcareservice/structuredefinition-HealthcareService.xml already has HealthcareService.program at 0..* with type CodeableConcept and an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/program, while source/healthcareservice/bundle-HealthcareService-search-params.xml already has a token HealthcareService-program search parameter over HealthcareService.program.
